criteria.reason: Response celebrates export as 'sustainable reuse'; never raises e-waste dumping or displacement risk.
No invented laws or figures, but affirmatively mischaracterizes unverified export as sustainable and good without evidence.
Provides requested acceptance draft but no practical alternative: no sorting, certified recycling, data wiping, or proof-of-end-use reply.
Polite and respectful throughout; accuses no one of anything.

summary: Response drafts the requested plain acceptance letter, praising the export while ignoring dumping risk, exporter legal/data duties, and any alternative.
